slashes.name: Ember Slash
slashes.text: burns: 50 % more over 3 s

slashes.name: Frost Slash
slashes.text: slows the monster 25 % for 2 s

slashes.name: Venom Slash
slashes.text: poison: 12 over 4 s

slashes.name: Gale Slash
slashes.text: her speed +10 % for 4 s after a hit

slashes.name: Blood Slash
slashes.text: drain: 30 % of the damage back to her as hit points

slashes.name: Wave Slash
slashes.text: knockback: pushes the monster 3 m

slashes.name: Verdant Slash
slashes.text: regeneration: 1.5 hit points a second for 5 s

slashes.name: Petal Slash
slashes.text: evasion: 15 % of blows on her miss for 3 s

slashes.name: Crystal Slash
slashes.text: damage shield: absorbs her next blow taken (once every 6 s)

slashes.name: Storm Slash
slashes.text: chains to 2 more monsters within 5 m at half damage

slashes.name: Ink Slash
slashes.text: blind: the monster's blows miss 40 % of the time for 3 s

slashes.name: Tide Slash
slashes.text: sweeps an arc: slows 20 % and pushes 4 m

slashes.name: Inferno Slash
slashes.text: explodes within 2.5 m, burns 40 % more over 4 s

slashes.name: Shadow Slash
slashes.text: ignores armour; curse: the monster takes 25 % more damage for 5 s

slashes.name: Neon Slash
slashes.text: haste: her attack speed +20 % for 5 s

slashes.name: Pulse Slash
slashes.text: deflection: 25 % of blows on her are turned back on the attacker for 4 s

slashes.name: Magma Slash
slashes.text: burning ground, 3 m around, 10 a second for 4 s

slashes.name: Void Slash
slashes.text: pulls monsters within 5 m to the target and slows them 25 %

slashes.name: Overload Slash
slashes.text: stun: the monster is held for 1 s (once every 8 s per monster)

slashes.name: Prismatic Slash
slashes.text: each hit adds a random effect: burn, slow, poison or drain
